data.cohort: Greek raw full-power (SBD) entries since 2015, OpenPowerlifting

conformal.method: split conformal, absolute-residual score, finite-sample quantile k = ceil((n_cal + 1)(1 - alpha)); 50/50 sex-stratified split of the test set

percentiles.cohort: all entries in cohort.csv (not the best-per-lifter), within sex
percentiles.strength_standing_metric: DOTS (2019 coefficients, bodyweight clamped 40-210 M / 40-150 F)

limitations: Optuna's 5-fold CV search used the full age cohort, including the test rows, so the test RMSE is slightly optimistic.
Interval width is fixed per confidence level and coverage is marginal, not per sex: women are over-covered and men slightly under-covered at some levels.
The calibration and validation halves are small (about 183 rows each, about 37 women in validation), so the coverage figures carry wide sampling error.
Valid only for Greek raw full-power powerlifting; not for equipped powerlifting, bench-only meets, deadlift-only meets or other countries.
Inputs outside the training ranges are extrapolations.
